description: This file contains functions for checking relational integrity constraints between various database tables in the Mattermost server, including orphaned record detection and consistency checks for channels, commands, posts, schemes, sessions, teams, and users.

classes.name: relationalCheckConfig
classes.description: Configuration struct for relational integrity checks, specifying parent and child table names, attributes, filters, and options.

methods.name: getOrphanedRecords
methods.description: Retrieves records from a child table that do not have corresponding parent records, indicating orphaned records.

methods.name: checkParentChildIntegrity
methods.description: Performs an integrity check between parent and child tables based on provided configuration.

methods.name: checkChannelsCommandWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for command webhooks related to channels.

methods.name: checkChannelsChannelMemberHistoryIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for channel member history records.

methods.name: checkChannelsChannelMembersIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for channel members.

methods.name: checkChannelsIncomingWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for incoming webhooks in channels.

methods.name: checkChannelsOutgoingWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for outgoing webhooks in channels.

methods.name: checkChannelsPostsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for posts within channels.

methods.name: checkChannelsFileInfoIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for file info associated with channels.

methods.name: checkCommandsCommandWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for command webhooks related to commands.

methods.name: checkPostsFileInfoIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for file info related to posts.

methods.name: checkPostsPostsRootIdIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for root post references.

methods.name: checkPostsReactionsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for reactions on posts.

methods.name: checkSchemesChannelsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for channels within schemes.

methods.name: checkSchemesTeamsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for teams within schemes.

methods.name: checkSessionsAuditsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for audits within sessions.

methods.name: checkTeamsChannelsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for channels within teams, with filtering based on channel type.

methods.name: checkTeamsCommandsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for commands within teams.

methods.name: checkTeamsIncomingWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for incoming webhooks within teams.

methods.name: checkTeamsOutgoingWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for outgoing webhooks within teams.

methods.name: checkTeamsTeamMembersIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for team members.

methods.name: checkUsersAuditsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user audits.

methods.name: checkUsersCommandWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user command webhooks.

methods.name: checkUsersChannelMemberHistoryIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user channel member history.

methods.name: checkUsersChannelMembersIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user channel memberships.

methods.name: checkUsersChannelsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for channels created by users.

methods.name: checkUsersCommandsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user commands.

methods.name: checkUsersCompliancesIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user compliances.

methods.name: checkUsersEmojiIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user emojis.

methods.name: checkUsersFileInfoIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user file info.

methods.name: checkUsersIncomingWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user incoming webhooks.

methods.name: checkUsersOAuthAccessDataIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for OAuth access data for users.

methods.name: checkUsersOAuthAppsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for OAuth applications associated with users.

methods.name: checkUsersOAuthAuthDataIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for OAuth auth data for users.

methods.name: checkUsersOutgoingWebhooksIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user outgoing webhooks.

methods.name: checkUsersPostsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user posts.

methods.name: checkUsersPreferencesIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user preferences.

methods.name: checkUsersReactionsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user reactions.

methods.name: checkUsersSessionsIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user sessions.

methods.name: checkUsersStatusIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user status.

methods.name: checkUsersTeamMembersIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user team memberships.

methods.name: checkUsersUserAccessTokensIntegrity
methods.description: Checks integrity for user access tokens.

methods.name: checkChannelsIntegrity
methods.description: Runs all channel-related integrity checks and sends results to a channel.

methods.name: checkCommandsIntegrity
methods.description: Runs command-related integrity checks.

methods.name: CheckRelationalIntegrity
